overview: The Mosinee School Board Finance and Building Committee met on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 and approved the November 17, 2026 voucher list and accepted the October 2026 Treasurer's Report, both unanimously. The two-member quorum, consisting of Diane Gorman and Derek Nest, also reviewed an SRO invoice but took no action on it. Old business items covering the 10-year construction plan and a playground project were discussed without action.
committee: Finance and Building Committee — Mosinee School Board

agenda.item: Approval of Minutes — October 27, 2026 Finance & Building Committee Meeting
Old Business: Discussion and Review — 10 Year Construction Plan
Old Business: Discussion and Review — Playground Project
New Business: Approval of Monthly Voucher List
New Business: Acceptance of Monthly Treasurer's Report

discussions.body: The committee discussed and reviewed the 10-year construction plan. No action was taken.
The committee discussed and reviewed the playground project. No action was taken.
Gorman moved and Nest seconded to approve the November 17, 2026 voucher list as presented. The voice vote carried unanimously 2-0.
Nest moved and Gorman seconded to accept the Treasurer's Report as presented for the month ending October 31, 2026. The voice vote carried unanimously 2-0.
The committee reviewed Invoice #2026-1027-01 and associated time logs. No action was taken.

The committee identified two items for upcoming meetings: an FD73 meeting with Foster & Foster scheduled for December 15, 2026, and a discussion of FD46 funding and usage strategies, with the committee expressing interest in establishing guidelines such as a fund balance minimum for FD46.
